nodes.question: How did Ahmad et al. (2022) address the issue of dangerous chemicals in industrial effluents, and what technologies did they explore for their removal?
nodes.answer: Ahmad et al. (2022) surveyed the latest improvements in discarding dangerous chemicals from industrial effluents using adsorption, membrane technologies, advanced oxidation processes (AOP), Fenton-based processes, and emir-adsorption.
